provenance.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI)
provenance.note: Corpus files are the consolidated Article text with EUR-Lex consolidation markers (▼B, ▼M1), markdown link syntax, non-breaking spaces and soft hyphens removed. See src/lib/rulepack/normalise.ts — the citation verifier applies the same normalisation to both sides before matching.

changelog: Adds Articles 10, 14, 15, 16 and 43 to the corpus — data and data governance, human oversight, accuracy/robustness/cybersecurity, the provider obligations list, and conformity assessment. Nothing else changed: the twenty carry-over corpus files and the four data files are byte-identical to 2026-08-18 and their hashes here are the same values, which is the evidence rather than a claim. corpusCutOff is unchanged at 2026-07-27 and the CELEX is the same consolidation (02024R1689-20260727); the five new files were fetched from it on 2026-08-19 via scripts/rulepack-fetch-article.ts, which refuses to write unless the served document's own consolidation date matches this manifest. The fetcher was validated by re-fetching Article 9 and confirming it normalises to the hash already recorded for it. NOTE ON SHAPE: the five new files carry each lettered point on one line ("(a) the relevant design choices;"), as annex-iii.txt does, because that is what scripts/regulatory/extract.ts emits; the original nineteen Articles put the marker in its own block. The two forms are identical after normalisation — whitespace runs collapse — so a citation verifies the same either way, and no bespoke reshaping of statutory text was introduced to make them look alike. WHY: Compliance Checker v2's high-risk provider path emitted six of Chapter III Section 2's duties and carried a finding admitting the list was short, because a citation to an Article outside the corpus returns 'uncovered' from verifyCitation() and must be treated as unverifiable rather than as a pass. Article 43 in particular decides which conformity assessment procedure applies, and the answer differs by Annex III point. Carried forward from 2026-08-10: Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, OJ 24.7.2026, in force 27.7.2026) — Annex III high-risk from 2 Dec 2027; Annex I from 2 Aug 2028; new Art 5(1)(ba) and (bb) prohibitions from 2 Dec 2026; SMC category (Arts 11, 17, 57, 99(6a)); Art 50 transparency in force 2 Aug 2026; penalty tiers at EUR 15M/3% for Art 50 and GPAI (Arts 99(4)(g), 101); the Art 6(3) profiling override; retention at Arts 19(1)/26(6) with Art 12 as the logging capability only; Art 57(1) sandbox deadline 2 Aug 2027.
